findings.passage: “Only U.S. citizens should vote in U.S. elections,” said Rep. Hern. “By closing loopholes and reinforcing accountability, we help ensure Americans' voices are accurately represented when they cast their ballots. The overwhelming majority of Americans support requiring ID to vote, and I’m proud to have cosponsored and helped pass this commonsense legislation out of the House so we can begin restoring trust in our elections.”
findings.note: Quote in his official press release 'Hern Votes to Restore Election Integrity', issued the day of his vote for the SAVE America Act. He says he cosponsored it and supports requiring ID to vote.

findings.passage: Congressman Kevin Hern (OK-01) voted today in support of the SAVE America Act, which protects the voice of every lawful American voter by requiring proof of citizenship for voter registration and photo ID when voting in federal elections, and ordering states to remove noncitizens from their lists of eligible voters.
findings.note: Statement issued by his office describing the SAVE America Act as requiring proof of citizenship to register, photo ID at federal elections, and removal of noncitizens from voter lists. The release also says the bill allows various forms of documentation and of photo ID, with provisions for name changes.

findings.passage: “The SAVE Act is simple: only American citizens can vote in our elections,” said Chairman Hern. “It’s not controversial, it’s just common sense! After four years of dangerous open border policies, I’m proud to work alongside the Trump Administration to secure our border and protect Americans from Biden’s failed policies.”
findings.note: Quote in his official press release on House passage of H.R. 22, the SAVE Act, which he describes as requiring proof of citizenship to register to vote in federal elections. He ties it to border security.

findings.passage: I am proud to cosponsor the SAVE America Act. Only American citizens should vote in American elections. The SAVE America Act, along with related legislation, has passed the House of Representatives multiple times with my support. This legislation would simply ensure that an individual provides proof of citizenship when registering to vote and photo identification when at the polls. These commonsense reforms are supported by the vast majority of Republicans, Democrats, and Independents. If elected to the Senate, I will continue to fight to ensure that the SAVE America Act is enacted into law.
findings.note: Senate campaign site 'promises kept' page (undated; it refers to Trump's first year back, so written in 2026). He says he cosponsors the SAVE America Act and will push for it in the Senate.

findings.passage: I voted against the Democrats so-called For the People Act (H.R.1) which would interject more Washington cronyism between voters and the ballot box, restrict their first amendment rights, and limit our states’ authority to administer their own electoral process.
findings.note: Senate campaign site (undated, 2026). He describes his vote against H.R. 1, For the People Act, as protecting states' authority to run their own elections. Related to election rules in general, not to ID itself.
